stories.headline: Nvidia confirms immediate CEO transition
stories.summary: Nvidia confirmed Jensen Huang left its CEO and board roles. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO while retaining her finance role; the company is searching for a permanent successor.

stories.headline: Microsoft 365 disruption stretches past 12 hours
stories.summary: Reuters' latest report describes a prolonged disruption affecting Outlook, Teams and Copilot. Microsoft reported stabilization measures; full recovery at briefing time was not independently confirmed.

stories.headline: US AI task force discusses cyberattack reporting
stories.summary: The White House AI task force discussed AI-powered cyberattacks, critical infrastructure vulnerabilities and incident-reporting standards. These are discussions, not a newly enacted reporting mandate.

stories.headline: Iran claims attack on US radar in Bahrain
stories.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they targeted a US early-warning radar in Bahrain. The report did not independently establish a successful hit or damage; no immediate US or Bahraini response was reported.

stories.headline: US envoy reports Ukraine talks and exchange plans
stories.summary: Jared Kushner said Russia and Ukraine agreed to include European nations in upcoming talks. He described work toward a major prisoner exchange; planned releases are not completed releases, and territorial disputes remain.
